translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

book.name: Don Sane
book.title: Yohaneŋo Don San Papaine Ea Ra Qelaŋange

content: Yohaneŋo Qeliwo Bakom Kito Kito Eŋet Detke So Anutu Wane Sea Kake

Iwa ka detka okanbe qoeki, ea wane ŋadino na dene koso zingeke, paki, na dene pore kawe, qeliwo madet mane qoe aŋago okorake. Pakiso, don mane romon ukatne yale, na mo alakan nolatki detkakole, eaŋo nolale rake, “Iwa sanom, mo na baŋ tanik daleo iwa wane ŋadino wakoniake, ea sikanganbe.”
Raki eaka Asuŋo wetne maingeke, yewa qeli kotino kawe, ŋei waom sea mane metke, ŋei maneŋo ea wane kutno pese metke.
Eŋane kaitine qilaune kilitike okorake, yemo wesi mane zaspa so kornilian wane kibine yale, ŋei waom sea ea yemo korop wagin maneŋo lolikkake, kibine wisika wisika.
Ŋei waom sea ea keuo metki ŋei waom sea natne 24 yaleŋo lolikka met warekoi. Sea ea wanekutno ŋei sele 24 edo takot libekaŋo birau paki ŋei waom marok golŋo mamaine ea kitou paki metwarekoi.
Ŋei waom sea suaine ea ŋine kilitikki qilap, ukat so quruŋ wakone pake. Ŋei waom sea ea wane kaitko yemo kiwa 7, kiwa kiwa kine ea lawe okorakoi, ea yemo Anutu wane Asu 7.

Ŋei waom sea ea wane kaitko kiwet mane, wikinŋo mamaine yale, qelaŋane weneŋ ais gununutne yale pake. Keuo, ŋei waom sea lolikka metkoi, yemo kine kine gegeenerop 4, kaitene so ŋadine deeneŋoka korop kawet kawareke.
Kine kine gegeenerop mane, ea eŋe tanikine laion yale. Mane naba 2, ea tanikine bulamaka ŋei yale, naba 3, ea kaitine ŋei kait yale, so naba 4, ea yemo tunpokŋo riwe arimaike, yale.
Kine kine 4 gegeenerop iwa eŋe qingimene 6, so qingimene kotino so solaine ea korop deeneŋoka kawet kawareke. Eŋe goigo me kaiweo eŋet mane kito mi qeli qeliŋene, iwa yale ra okanmami,

content.text: “Koboboine, koboboine, koboboine, Waom Anutu eŋe togogole, eŋe mokaka geke, eŋe iwa gemaike, so eŋe sariake.”

content: Kine kine gegeenerop 4 yewa, eŋe ŋei waom seako metmaike, eŋe naso baŋem gege togon ge ariake, eŋane qeli ewe zonominane mawakau paki, bakom eŋet kitokoi.

Eŋe yale okanbiso, ŋei sele 24, eŋe ŋei waom seako met okanmaike, eŋe naso baŋem gege togon ge ariake, eŋane osino umi qe more meŋenkamami. Eŋe ŋei waom marokene, ea ŋei waom sea osino motpi paki, iwa yale ramami,

content.text: “Ŋenane Waom so Anutu! Ge maine kopŋono ea wane qeli ewe, so bakom kito kito, so zonom makene. Goŋo yeye kine kine korop ma wakongone, so geŋone wetŋonane ranom wakonwareke, so iwa pamaike.”
